enclosure.notes: CORRECTED 2026-09-28 from side-by-side model-vs-photo comparison. The previous profile (sharp elbow at ~33% depth, steep straight ramp, front 1.20) exaggerated the step. The real pedal is a smooth, gentle wedge: rear deck approximately flat for the rear ~40% of depth, then a subtle, smooth bend easing at z=-0.49 into a gentle straight slope to the front. No hard kink. Segment slopes ease ~5/14/17/19/19 deg. Back/front = 2.09/1.08 = 1.94x (model previously only ~1.7x). ALL profile y values are photo-estimated (soft); front height 1.08 is the softest number. bevel 0.07 rounds the rear-top corner more than the extrude default; frontLean 0.06 gives a slightly sloped front face.
